reviewedSemantics: MainnetSettler execute always ends with _checkSlippageAndTransfer; the permitted EKUBOV3 action does not modify the slippage struct. CHECK_SLIPPAGE and SELECT remain unsupported.

TRANSFER_FROM under Permit2PaymentTakerSubmitted interprets MAX_UINT256 as the full forwarded sender balance. Only this encoding, with tracked bridge funds, is supported; partial ratios remain unresolved.
EKUBOV3 is enabled only for this Ethereum deployment, while the existing funding, target/operator, recipient and positive slippage minimum checks remain required.
Only execute(bytes,bytes[]) with one required V4_SWAP command (0x10) and exactly SWAP_EXACT_IN, SETTLE, TAKE (0x070b0e) is supported.
The verified v2.1.2 ExactInputParams includes minHopPriceX36 between path and amountIn; older layouts are not assumed.
One ERC20 hop without hooks, positive uint128 input/output minimum, SETTLE from Router for full debt and TAKE of full output credit to Handler are required.
Across must immediately prefund this Router via drainLeftoverTokens with the same token and tracked amount. Different success/fallback assets leave output token and amount unresolved.
publishAndFund binds the destination chain and encoded route in the intent hash. Inbox validates its own portal and the route hash before funding Executor.
Executor executes the route calls in order and reverts on any failure.

Only the HyperEVM Portal with one canonical USDC route asset and an exact zero-value approve + Circle TokenMessengerV2 depositForBurn pair is recognized. Burn amount must equal route funding and approval.
The final destination chain, direct mint recipient, USDC and amount less maxFee come from CCTP. Fixed ClaimExecutor recipients and arbitrary compositions remain unresolved.
